Chapter 7 - Translation Manager / Translation Extension Reference
Translation Extension Routines

Managing Translation Progress Dialog Boxes

You can use the SetTranslationAdvertisement function to display the progress dialog box and, optionally, to include a logo or other identifying picture in the
progress dialog box. You can use the UpdateTranslationProgress function to show the user the progress of a translation and allow the user to cancel a translation.
